candidates.topic: Full Moon in Aries — Five Planets Retrograde Collision
candidates.teaser: There's a Full Moon in Aries happening while FIVE planets are retrograde at the same time — does that make tonight dangerous or just incredibly intense?
candidates.video_title: Full Moon in Aries — 5 Planets Retrograde Right Now
candidates.video_description: Tonight's Full Moon in Aries collides with five simultaneous retrogrades, including Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Astrologers say this is one of the most charged lunations of the year. Here's what it means.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde tonight — and the Full Moon is in Aries. That is not a coincidence you scroll past. In astrology, Aries Full Moons are already explosive — they pull at your anger, your identity, your unfinished fights. But with Mercury retrograde in Scorpio, Venus retrograde in Scorpio, and Saturn retrograde right there in Aries at 9 degrees, this Moon is being compressed on all sides. Something is being forced to a head. Which area of your life feels like it's been holding its breath?

candidates.topic: Mercury Retrograde in Scorpio — Now Active Until Nov 13
candidates.teaser: Mercury retrograde just started in the most secretive sign in the zodiac — and it doesn't end until November 13th. What exactly is it digging up?
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde in Scorpio — Starts Now, Ends Nov 13
candidates.video_description: Mercury retrograde is now active in Scorpio, running through November 13th. In astrology, Scorpio rules secrets, power, and what's buried. Astrologers warn this retrograde hits communications, contracts, and old truths harder than most.
candidates.script: Mercury retrograde just began — and it's sitting at 21 degrees Scorpio. This one is different. Scorpio doesn't do surface-level confusion like a typical Mercury retrograde. In astrology, Scorpio rules hidden information, psychological patterns, and things people deliberately buried. This retrograde runs until November 13th, and it's asking you to revisit what you thought was resolved — contracts, confessions, old conversations that never got a real answer. The truth that comes back up might surprise you.

candidates.topic: Sun and Venus Both at 1° Scorpio — Rare Overlap
candidates.teaser: The Sun and Venus are sitting at almost the exact same degree of Scorpio right now — astrologers say this alignment only happens once a year at best, and this one carries extra weight.
candidates.video_title: Sun Conjunct Venus in Scorpio — What This Rare Overlap Means
candidates.video_description: The Sun is at 1.3° Scorpio and Venus is at 0.4° Scorpio — nearly conjunct. Venus is also retrograde. Astrologers interpret this as a forced reexamination of Scorpionic themes: desire, power, intimacy, and worth.
candidates.script: Right now the Sun and Venus are less than one degree apart — both sitting at the very beginning of Scorpio. In astrology, a Sun-Venus conjunction already softens and deepens the heart. But Venus is retrograde here, which completely flips the meaning. Instead of attracting new things, this conjunction is pulling you back toward what you already lost or left behind — a relationship, a value, a version of yourself you gave up too easily. What did you walk away from that still has a hold on you?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Conjunct the Full Moon
candidates.teaser: Saturn retrograde is sitting at 9 degrees Aries — right next to tonight's Full Moon — and astrologers say that combination forces a reckoning most people are not ready for.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde Conjunct Full Moon in Aries Tonight
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde is at 9.8° Aries, placing it in close conjunction with tonight's Full Moon at 12° Aries. In astrology, Saturn next to a Full Moon amplifies themes of consequence, restriction, and accountability. This lunation may feel heavier than most.
candidates.script: Saturn retrograde is at 9 degrees Aries — and tonight's Full Moon is at 12 degrees Aries. They are sitting right next to each other in the sky. In astrology, Saturn next to a Full Moon means the emotional peak this lunation brings doesn't get to just dissolve quietly. Saturn demands accountability. It asks what structure you've been avoiding, what responsibility you've been outrunning. If something reaches a breaking point tonight, that's not bad luck — that's Saturn finally making you look.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 1st House — Aries, Mars, and the Self
candidates.teaser: The 1st house in your birth chart is the most personal placement you have — and most people only half-understand what it actually controls.
candidates.video_title: The 1st House — The Most Personal Spot in Your Birth Chart
candidates.video_description: The 1st house rules identity, physical appearance, first impressions, and how you instinctively meet the world. Ruled by Aries and Mars in traditional astrology, it sets the tone for your entire chart. Here's what astrologers say it really means.
candidates.script: The 1st house is the first thing any astrologer looks at in your chart — and it's the one placement nobody fully explains. In astrology, it's ruled by Aries and Mars, and it governs your physical body, your instinctive reactions, and the very first impression you make before you say a single word. Your rising sign sits here. But the 1st house isn't just how others see you — it's the raw, unfiltered version of you that shows up before your personality has time to edit itself. What's yours?
